Evan: Hi all — Evan here, excited to join the infra team today! Quick run of onboarding security questions: 1) Im remote and will be using a personal Mac for the next week. Do I need to enroll immediately or can I do the company laptop flow later? 2) How intrusive is the MDM report (will it list my personal app names?) 3) Where do I pick up a YubiKey or request one shipped?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Evan :wave: Congrats! If you plan to use your personal Mac for work we require MDM + FileVault before accessing any repos or internal docs. If you want a company laptop instead, submit the hardware request form and choose "remote new hire" — we can ship next-day in most zones.
Zara (Security): @Evan hi — short answers: 1) Enroll asap if you need repo or Jira access today; otherwise you can request a loaner and delay enrollment. 2) Our MDM reports OS version, disk encryption status, installed company profiles and device name only; we do not inventory personal files or app contents. 3) Ops Desk handles security tokens — @Ops Desk can confirm shipping.
Evan: Thanks. For FileVault, how do I check and enable quickly?
Zara (Security): On macOS run: ```fdesetup status``` — it should return "FileVault is On." To enable: System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault. If you hit errors, paste the output here or open a ticket with security.
Evan: I tried `fdesetup status` and it says "FileVault is Off" — what next?
Zara (Security): Try enabling via UI first. If it asks for an iCloud key, choose to create a recovery key and save it to your manager-approved place, or we can provision a company escrow key via our device workflow. If encryption stalls, ping us with the console output.
Evan: Got it — one more: phishing sims — do they come during my first week? I'd like to avoid making a mistake right away.
security-bot: Automated notice: Phishing simulations are scheduled quarterly. New hires are typically included after day 3 of onboarding. Sim emails come from simulation@redwood-security.test and include "[Redwood Simulation]" in the subject. If you report an exercise, you'll receive a short microtraining. See: https://intranet.redwood.com/security/phishing-sims
Evan: Good to know. How about passkeys vs YubiKey? Are passkeys acceptable for devs?
Zara (Security): Passkeys are supported for most SSO apps. However, anyone with infra or customer-access requires a phishing-resistant second factor (hardware FIDO2 key). We recommend carrying a YubiKey, but we can ship one to you.
Ops Desk: Hi @Evan — we can ship a YubiKey and a loaner laptop. Please fill the hardware request form (link: https://forms.redwood.com/loaner-laptop) and mark shipping address + "security token" in notes. Reply here once submitted and well queue it.
Evan: Form submitted (tracking number included). Thank you!
Maya (People Ops): Welcome again :tada: if you need help with the MDM enrollment steps, DM me and well hop on a quick screen share. Also ping this thread after you enable FileVault so security can close your access checklist.
Evan: Will do, appreciate the help :thumbsup:
